description: dataset för manuskriptet "Överskridande av fyllnadsfaktorgränsen för organiska solceller" is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Linköpings universitet. Data for main text Figure 1-5 and SI figures. Coverage: Linköpings universitet. The portal shows the English title as "dataset for the manuscript "Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells"" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Linköpings universitet. Its keywords include Electronic material, Optics and Photonics, Condensed matter physics, Physics. The listing shows 2026-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
